findingClass: a child row in a multi-row table (financial_statements / promoters / ipo_intermediaries / peer_companies) carries no field_sources entry for its own row_key — provenance was written under the '' catch-all default, so a fact from FY2023 is recorded against the same key as FY2024 and the second write silently overwrites the first. Nothing in the schema stops it ('' is a legal row_key), so only an independent read can see it.
failThreshold: any (ipo_id, table_name) pair with MORE THAN ONE row in one of the four child tables, where that pair already has at least one NON-EMPTY row_key in field_sources (i.e. a row-keyed writer is live for it) and at least one derived child row key has no field_sources row
unverifiableWhen: every multi-row (ipo, table) pair carries provenance ONLY under the '' catch-all key — the row-keyed writer is not live yet, so per-row provenance cannot be judged. This is today's state (both callers of consolidateIPOData pass tableName 'ipos'; the four child tables are still written directly by filing-persister), and it reports UNVERIFIABLE rather than PASS on purpose: a PASS here would be permanently, meaninglessly green through exactly the transition the check exists to police, and indistinguishable from a broken check. Also UNVERIFIABLE when the child tables or field_sources are unreadable.
note: The enforcement switch is automatic and PER PAIR — the moment field_sources holds one non-empty row_key for a pair, that pair is judged for real. There is no flag to flip and no way for the check to go permanently green by accident. Row keys are derived from each child row's OWN identity columns (fiscal_year:basis; normalized promoter name; role:normalized name; normalized peer company name — the item-01 card's row-key table), never from the denormalized normalized_name column the path under audit wrote. Distinct from d_segment_provenance (one field on the singleton ipos row) and p_document_provenance_share (a source-mix ratio): this is the only check that asserts provenance exists PER CHILD ROW. Named residual limit: a writer that lands and keys NOTHING leaves every pair NOT-YET-KEYED, so this check pages P2 nightly rather than FAILs — loud, not silent, but the writer slice's own row-key round-trip test is the hard gate for that case.
